newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt paper prices mixed, rouble stable.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt paper prices mixed, rouble stable.

text.p: Issues of long-term Russian GKO discount Treasury bills rose on Monday, while shorter issues were mixed due to the completion of pre-holiday speculation, dealers said. Russian markets were closed May 9-11.
Overnight rouble/dollar rates fell, while the rouble for today and tomorrow delivery remained stable.
roubles/dollar May 12 midday May 12 early May 8 close
Dealers said the rouble/dollar market was quiet as banks without large client orders were not inclined to speculate.

"In the morning there were (client) sell dollar orders and the dollar slipped, but in general quotes with today settlement are stable," said Bank Menatep chief dealer Mikhail Zaretsky. "There is not much wish to speculate upwards, and there is nowhere to speculate downwards."
Government paper traders said long-term paper, which was not in much demand before the holidays, was attractive.
Aljba-Alliance head of government paper Andrei Semyonov said short and medium-term paper was overheated before the holidays as operators had hoped for gains in these sectors
